fixes.en: We found a Vajra nest and began a survey, aiming to grab a cocoon if possible,\nbut the Vajra spotted us almost at once. Move swiftly to wipe them out.
fixes.why: refit: tightened wording; 'as soon as the survey began' -> 'almost at once'; matched to row 495 (identical Japanese, refit in story2)

fixes.en: A concert tour crew visiting planet Gallia 4 to boost morale has been taken\nhostage by rioting Zentradi. Wipe out the rioting Zentradi to rescue them.
fixes.why: refit: rebalanced lines; 'morale-boosting concert tour' reworded

fixes.en: The Global, 117th Research Fleet flagship found on planet Gallia 4, has become\na Vajra lair. To stop the Vajra breeding, clear out every Vajra cocoon aboard.
The Global, 117th Research Fleet flagship found on planet Gallia 4, has become\na Vajra lair. To stop the Vajra breeding, clear out every Vajra cocoon aboard.
Organized Vajra attacks have put the Frontier fleet in grave danger.\nHead for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving orders. Destroy it at once.
Organized Vajra attacks have put the Frontier fleet in grave danger.\nHead for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving orders. Destroy it at once.
Top-secret mission: you will now guard an experiment using Ranka Lee's song.\nUntil the experiment begins, wipe out the Vajra so they can't interfere.
Evolved Vajra have appeared that even reaction weapons can't harm. They will be\nhard to destroy, so put defending the Macross Quarter and your survival first.

To end the war with the Vajra, a super-long-distance fold has been decided on.\nDefend the Battle Frontier until the super-long-distance fold begins.
A Vajra nest was apparently built inside Macross Frontier, and swarms of Vajra\nare rampaging inside. Wipe out the Vajra that have emerged in the Frontier.

fixes.en: Some S.M.S. members are trying to hijack the Macross Quarter and escape.\nAt this rate they'll fold away. You're authorized to shoot down the deserters.
A mock battle will now be held to test the VF-171EX, built to fight the Vajra.\nDefeat the Sagittarius Squadron in this combined machine test and training.
At last we've found the Vajra homeworld. Our only way to survive is to make it\nour new home. Wipe out the Vajra, powered by the Galactic Fairy's song.
At last we've found the Vajra homeworld. Our only way to survive is to make it\nour new home. Wipe out the Vajra, powered by the Galactic Fairy's song.
Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the\ntrue masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.
Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the\ntrue masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

We sensed our kin's fold waves and began a rescue, but new unknown entities\nappeared to hinder it. We shall annihilate the entities hindering the rescue.
Your key is in my hand, and the queen's throne is already mine.\nGo now, Vajra. My eyes, my ears, my limbs. Strike with your mighty claws!
fixes.why: refit: 'those mighty claws of yours' -> 'your mighty claws'

fixes.en: An unknown fleet, likely rogue Zentradi forces, has been spotted near Jupiter.\nBreak the enemy's will to fight with Operation Minmay, then wipe them out.
Mecha from a mysterious fleet slipped through our defenses and invaded Earth.\nWipe out the mobile weapons ravaging the city as if seeking something. Now!
The Mardook forces have launched an all-out assault to destroy Earth's culture.\nProtect Earth's culture at all costs and wipe out the Mardook forces.
Starting the op to retake the relay base held by anti-U.N. group Vindirance.\nInfiltrate via the canyon leading to the base and wipe out Vindirance's guards.
Starting the op to retake the relay base held by anti-U.N. group Vindirance.\nInfiltrate via the canyon leading to the base and wipe out Vindirance's guards.
Vindirance is plotting a fold to Earth. It must be stopped at all costs, so\nreaction weapons are authorized for this operation. Wipe out Vindirance.
We will now descend to Earth and infiltrate Macross City. To shatter Latence's\nambitions, destroy the wide-area jamming system in the head of the Macross.
fixes.why: refit: moved clause across break; 'mounted in' -> 'in'

fixes.en: Variable fighters, developed using the OverTechnology of the Macross.\nTo learn how they evolved, battle the variable fighters of every generation.
Venue security test for Fire Bomber's special live: can you stay cool through\nBasara and the band's red-hot songs? Win the mock battle vs. Fire Bomber.
fixes.why: refit: restructured as a test question

fixes.en: Basara: "Now it's red-hot live time! We'll slam our hearts right into you!\n         So let's go big and flashy! Get wild and FIRE!"
The Macross that ended the interstellar war passed its name on to colony ships.\nMake it out alive from Macross Heaven, packed with ships bearing that name.
fixes.why: refit: restructured; dropped 'that travel the galaxy'

fixes.en: The enemy is throwing sheer numbers at us. Teach them that "quality" beats\n"quantity" in battle: sweep away the small-fry horde in the wasteland at once.
The enemy is throwing sheer numbers at us. Teach them that "quality" beats\n"quantity" in battle: sweep away the small-fry horde in the wasteland at once.
Sheryl: "From here on, it's special live time. Are you ready, Ranka-chan?"\nRanka: "Yes! So... everyone, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!! Kira☆"
fixes.why: refit: 'All the way to the ends of the galaxyyy' -> 'To the ends of the galaxy'

fixes.en: Dr. Editor-in-Chief Nishioka formed Editorial Sentai Dengeki V for world peace!\nWhen these Dengeki editors' hearts unite, their giant robot smashes evil!!
fixes.why: refit: restructured; dropped quotes around team name

fixes.en: To guard a prized collection, Hamamura Tsushin made the Weekly Famitsu office\na super dimension fortress. Find out what collection is worth going that far.
fixes.why: refit: restructured; 'editorial office' -> 'office'; 'worth going that far to protect' -> 'worth going that far'

fixes.en: Wipe out the Regults rampaging in the city now, but we sense a "giant" power\nbehind them, so never drop your guard. Annihilate those with "giant" power.
A mock battle now begins vs. the special forces unit codenamed "Moon Island".\nThey're all problem children, but reportedly skilled. Defeat Moon Island.
fixes.why: refit: tightened; 'Moon Island Platoon' -> 'Moon Island' as in source

fixes.en: Roy Focker: the U.N. ace who loves booze, women, and above all the open sky.\nDefeat Focker, whose skills have made him the very model of a pilot.
Shin Kudo washed up on Mayan Island and grew through the many people he met.\nDefeat Shin, the idiot who'd throw his life away for the woman he holds dear.
Sara Nome, Guide of the Wind, charged with stopping the Bird Human's revival.\nDefeat the Bird Human, revived in spite of all her efforts.
Genius pilot Max and ace Milia, who made the first-ever interstellar marriage.\nDefeat the Jenius couple, also a bridge to peace with the Zentradi.
Golg Boddole Zer: Zentradi fleet Supreme Commander over a full 5 million ships.\nDefeat the ruthless Boddole Zer, who'd readily kill his own troops to win.
Isamu and Guld: stuck together since childhood, they fight whenever they meet.\nDefeat the Dalmatian High School duo, seemingly at odds but friends at heart.
Maximilian Jenius, space carrier Battle 7's captain and a commander of genius.\nDefeat the Battle 7, which fought its way through the fierce Protodeviln war.
Gavil, a Protodeviln with a unique sense of beauty, and Glavil, a monster-like\nProtodeviln of immense combat power. Defeat the Beauty and the Monster.
His Excellency Gepelnitchi: Varauta supreme commander, mightiest Protodeviln.\nDefeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi, who could drain the galaxy of its Spiritia.
Gamlin Kizaki, elite pilot of the U.N. Forces' Diamond Force.\nDefeat Gamlin, nicknamed "Martian" as a child for his wide forehead.
Graham, who hates and would kill the Galaxy Whales, and Basara, who was\nmoved to sing to them. Defeat these men burning with passion for the whales.
fixes.why: refit: moved break; 'Galaxy Whales' -> 'whales' on second mention

fixes.en: Ozma Lee: seasoned S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader, overprotective of his sister.\nDefeat Ozma, who smashed death flag after death flag throughout the story.
The Macross Quarter: ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the name Macross.\nDefeat the Macross Quarter, captained by Jeffrey Wilder.
Klan Klang, Pixie Team leader, clumsy not just in her genes but in love too.\nDefeat Klan, a maiden sunk in rage and grief after losing the one she loved.
"Being linked to you made it clear. However far you go, people are alone!"\n"That's why we...!", "But!!", "It's precisely because we're alone that...",
Manipulated by Grace, Ranka Lee guards the Vajra planet to atone for her sins.\nDefeat Ranka, who sings to protect the Vajra homeworld.
Even the Protoculture feared their power, envied it, and at last deified them,\ncopying their form: the super-dimensional Vajra. Defeat Grace's Vajra Queen.
Macross is full of giant battleships, and needless to say, so is this game.\nDefeat the giant enemy battleships making their debut in this game.
Ranka: "I, Ranka Lee, am gonna explain the basic Fighter mode controls!\n        I'm nervous I won't explain it well, but I'll do my best. Kira☆"
Ranka: "Okay! Next, I'll explain the basic GERWALK mode controls.\n        Listen to me and get the GERWALK mode controls down perfectly!"
Sheryl: "It's a pain, but next I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.\n         You've got ME explaining, so if you don't learn it, you'll be sorry."
Ranka: "Umm... here I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.\n        It's tough with so much to learn, but I'll do my best explaining too!"
Sheryl: "Here I'll mostly explain the special maneuvers related to piloting.\n         If you're aiming to go pro, you'd better learn at least this much."
Ranka: "Here I'll mainly explain the SP-related special maneuvers.\n        They look a bit hard, but listen closely and learn them well, okay?"
Sheryl: "Here I'll explain the controls that changed since the previous game."\nRanka: "Explaining with Sheryl makes me nervous, but I'll do my best!"
